messages:
deploy-bot: post-release smoke completed for release v2026.03.21. eu1 kvprobe p95=420ms (baseline 280ms), error-rate=0.6% (threshold 0.2%). tagging @oncall and #eng-releases. link: https://deploy.internal/runs/6123
amy: saw that in datadog dashboards — queue depth on kv-worker-eu1 up ~3x around the same time
josh: also seeing a few 503s in the proxy logs, tail: `proxy[europe-1]: 2026-03-21T09:12:11Z 503 GET /kv/probe`
priya: which change touched kvprobe? last deploy notes show a small config tweak to prefill concurrency + new kernel flag
amy: yep, commit c3f8d8d changed prefill=on for eu1 only
priya: rolling back that config is low-risk, but we need to decide pin vs full rollback of the release
oncall: @priya please confirm if rollback affects dedicated customers (should be safe)
priya: confirmed: config is runtime flag, can flip without restart. no impact to dedicated pools
infra-ci-bot: triggered action: stage pin command queued: `pin-region eu1 to v2026.03.20` (awaiting human approve)
josh: +1 to pin and hold the rollout for eu1. let the rest of regions continue. minimizes customer impact
amy: agree. set telemetry check window 30m post-pin, p95 to return within 20% of baseline or we consider hotfix/rollback
priya: i'll flip the flag and pin now. calling it out in the release notes channel. assigning followups: @josh to monitor proxy traces, @amy to watch queue & kvmemory, @oncall to standby for rollback window
oncall: acknowledged. will escalate if error-rate >1%
priya: DONE — flag reverted in eu1 and infra pin applied. infra change-id: infra-789. monitoring for 30m
josh: initial signs good, errors dropping to 0.15% and p95 down to 310ms (within 10% of baseline). continuing to watch
amy: queue depth trending down
priya: keeping rollout paused for eu1 until 30m stable window completes. if stable we'll resume traffic shift and update release notes. closing action to open hotfix PR only if it reoccurs :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: noted action: rollout_hold(eu1) until 6119756121 (30m). recorded in release metadata
infra-ci-bot: created incident-ref if needed: inc-2026-031. no customer-visible impact reported
oncall: thanks all, will keep eyes until window closes
priya: will post final status here when window completes
